meta.title: Design system
meta.description: Clipealo’s tokens, brand components and product components, with usage rules and measured contrast.

hero.title: The Clipealo system.
hero.lead: A brand manual turned into tokens, components and rules. Everything you see on this page is the code the product uses: no screenshots.

color.title: Color
color.intro: Three OKLCH scales generated from the manual’s five colors. Each original color lands exactly on a step, so the palette extends the brand without betraying it.

semantic.title: Semantic
semantic.rule: Components only consume these. Changing a theme means reassigning this block, never touching the components.

orange.title: The orange rule
orange.rule: Orange marks the selected moment. If it shows up everywhere, it stops meaning that.
orange.correctNote: Just one orange action per view.
orange.incorrectNote: Three oranges compete and none of them wins.

typography.title: Typography
typography.intro: Climate Crisis for level 1 and 2 headings; DM Sans for everything else. Card subtitles use DM Sans bold: the display face becomes illegible at small sizes.
typography.display1: From long videos to great clips.
typography.subtitle: AI that finds the best moments
typography.body: It analyzes the audio, detects attention peaks and suggests the cuts. You save hours of editing and focus on creating.
typography.tabularNote: Every timecode uses fixed-width digits: otherwise the counter jitters during playback.

shape.title: Shape and depth
shape.intro: The base radius (0.875rem) is the same ratio as the isotype’s corners: 3.5 out of 32. Shadows are tinted with ink, never pure black.

brand.title: Brand
brand.intro: The isotype inherits currentColor, so it works on any background without duplicate variants. Only the accent square stays orange.

cropMark.title: Crop mark
cropMark.rule: It wraps the selected content. It’s decorative: it never carries text or its own focus.

controls.title: Controls
controls.intro: 47 shadcn/ui primitives on Radix, with the brand layer applied through tokens. Only the ones that differ from the original are shown here.

form.title: Form
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Say what the clip is about…

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.alertText: Review the highest-scoring ones before publishing.

video.title: Video components
video.intro: The layer that makes this a clipping platform and not a generic template. They all share the same language: orange = selected, blue = structure.

player.title: Player
player.rule: Custom controls so the clip range can be drawn on the bar. Keyboard: space, ← →, j/l, comma/period per frame, m, f, 0–9.

waveform.title: Waveform and trim
waveform.rule: The handles are the crop mark turned into a control. Keyboard: ← → (1 s), Shift (5 s), Alt (1 frame).

data.title: Data
data.intro: Only one featured metric per view. The categorical palette is validated for color blindness and contrast in light and dark; yellow and teal fall below 3:1 in light mode, so charts that use them get direct labels or a table view.

categorical.title: Categorical theme
categorical.rule: Fixed order, never cycled. A ninth value goes into “Other”, not a generated color.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.intro: Measured contrast, not estimated. Pairs that don’t reach AA are flagged with the alternative that does.

keyboard.operable: The player, the timeline and the trim can all be operated without a mouse.
keyboard.focus: Focus is always orange, 2 px thick with a 2 px offset.
keyboard.palette: ⌘K opens the command palette from anywhere in the app.

motion.auto: The landing page animates on its own at three moments: on load, only the hero (headline corners, playhead sweep and a shine across the tagline, all within 2 s); on entering the screen, just once per visit (headlines cut at 12 frames, cards, the quote word by word); and on scroll, only the reframe. Only the community carousel loops.
motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion reduces, it doesn’t remove: anything that moves or scales fades in place, the headline blade becomes a fade and the playhead sweep a flash. The reframe plays as four scroll-linked shots (16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16) with a fade at each cut, and celebration effects switch to a glow. Light, color, progress bars and word-by-word text stay the same.
motion.gestures: Anything that responds to a gesture stays: the 1 px press, color changes and notifications.
motion.sounds: Sounds only where they’re earned (main action, switches, milestones and errors), synthesized and can be turned off in Settings.

demo.title: A landing page section, in miniature
demo.rule: This is how it enters the screen: two groups, each with its own rhythm. With “reduce motion” you still see it all, as fades that stay in place.
demo.headline: Cut at 12 frames.
demo.lead: The eyebrow and the intro rise with a fade, and the headline is revealed in steps behind a blue blade.
demo.hover: With a mouse, the main action’s corners aim before they fire and the icons respond on hover.

readers.sliders: Custom sliders expose role, min, max and aria-valuetext as timecode.
readers.charts: Charts include a table view; nothing relies on color alone.

decision.title: Open decision: the orange CTA’s text
decision.description: The original design uses white text on #fd5e1c. Measured, that pair gives 3.09:1: enough for a graphical component (WCAG 1.4.11), not enough for text (AA requires 4.5:1). The system uses ink-950 by default, which gives 6.12:1. Compare and decide.
